description_en: Queries the workload usage trends of a specified endpoint device
description_zh: 查询指定终端设备的负载使用率趋势
name: GetUserDeviceWorkloadTrend

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint device ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries user endpoint devices in batches
parameters.help_zh:
终端设备ID。取值：
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: device_tag

parameters.help_en:
The workload type. Valid values:
cpu: CPU usage.
mem: memory usage
parameters.help_zh:
负载类型。取值：
cpu：CPU使用率。
mem：内存使用率
parameters.name: workload_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the value of To
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的起始时间，秒级时间戳。取值范围：大于或等于0，且小于To
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than the value of From
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的结束时间，秒级时间戳。取值范围：大于From
parameters.name: to

TitleEn.description_en:
The English name of the workload type. Valid values:
CPU Usage: returned when WorkloadType is set to cpu.
Memory Usage: returned when WorkloadType is set to mem
TitleEn.description_zh:
负载类型的英文名称。取值：
CPU Usage：WorkloadType取值为cpu时返回。
Memory Usage：WorkloadType取值为mem时返回

TitleZh.description_en:
The Chinese name of the workload type. Valid values:
CPU使用率: returned when WorkloadType is set to cpu.
内存使用率: returned when WorkloadType is set to mem
TitleZh.description_zh:
负载类型的中文名称。取值：
CPU使用率：WorkloadType取值为cpu时返回。
内存使用率：WorkloadType取值为mem时返回

WorkloadList.description_en: The list of workload trend data points, sorted by time in ascending order
WorkloadList.description_zh: 负载趋势数据点列表，按时间升序排列

Timestamp.description_en: The collection time of the data point. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 数据点的采集时间，秒级时间戳

Workload.description_en: The workload usage percentage. Valid values: 0 to 100, with two decimal places
Workload.description_zh: 负载使用率百分比。取值范围：0~100，保留两位小数
